products.name: npm 12 Readiness Check
products.deployment_verified: 2026-10-12 (v1.0.0): deploy-pages run 38205672261 succeeded; all assets 200, tests/ 404; live Playwright checks desktop 1280 + mobile 390 (sample, decision change, pin toggle, file upload, empty/invalid input, bad repo, 404 repo, live scan of jitsi/jitsi-meet: 1766 locked packages), 9/9 install scripts fetched from registry.npmjs.org under the live CSP, no console errors, no horizontal overflow; 25/25 unit tests; engine run on 8 real repos (vscode, cypress kitchensink, electron-quick-start, jitsi-meet, bitwarden/clients, puppeteer, typeorm) and 5 detection bugs fixed.
products.problem: npm 12 (12.0.0 Jul 8; 12.2.0 = registry latest since Sep 30, 2026) skips dependency preinstall/install/postinstall scripts unless approved in package.json allowScripts, and the install still exits 0, so Puppeteer/Prisma/sqlite3/bcrypt 5 fail later at runtime. It also refuses git and tarball-URL deps (allow-git/allow-remote=none), throws on unknown/abbreviated CLI flags, rejects --allow-scripts on project installs, removed shrinkwrap/adduser/star, and changed npm view --json. Node.js still bundles npm 11 or older, so it lands via npm i -g npm@latest, images, Corepack.
products.target_user: JavaScript/Node developers and CI maintainers using npm lockfiles who upgrade (or whose CI upgrades) to npm 12
evidence: Hands-on tests of popular packages under npm 12 https://nilaykabariya.blog/tested/npm-12-breaking-changes-tested

GitHub issues Oct 10-12, 2026: withastro/astro#17745 (package has install scripts not covered by allowScripts), pingdotgg/t3code#9398 (EALLOWSCRIPTS), earendil-works/pi#6600 (npm 11.16 warns, npm 12 blocks), npm/cli#9912 and #9835
Coverage Oct 2026: SecurityWeek, NodeSource 'not a silver bullet', CI migration playbooks (digitalapplied, codercops)
Real repos already adapting: microsoft/vscode and cypress-io/cypress-example-kitchensink commit allowScripts; jitsi/jitsi-meet has 6 git + 4 tarball deps (1 transitive) refused by default
existing_solutions: npm install-scripts ls/approve (needs npm 12 + installed tree; lists all scripts, no needed/not-needed verdict)
products.differentiation: Works before upgrading with no install: reads package-lock.json in the browser (or a public repo), fetches each package's real install script from the registry, gives a breaks / review / works-without verdict (documented list + script heuristics, version-aware e.g. bcrypt 5 vs 6), checks allowScripts coverage incl. stale pins, git/tarball deps incl. whether root is enough, CI/Docker lines (unknown/abbrev flags from npm's real 184 config names, EALLOWSCRIPTS, removed commands, Node engine), and generates allowScripts JSON + commands + .npmrc lines.
products.monetization: none now; possible later: GitHub Action that comments on PRs when a new dependency has an unapproved install script (free for public repos).
products.social_promotion: drafted (launch/npm12-check/posts.md), not published: X/Bluesky/Facebook/Mastodon/Threads not connected

changelog.change: initial release: lockfile install-script audit with registry script lookup + verdicts, allowScripts coverage/pins, git/remote deps, CI/Docker/package.json script scan, allowScripts/commands/.npmrc generator, public repo scan, Markdown checklist

products.name: Python 3.15 Readiness Check
products.deployment_verified: 2026-10-13 (v1.0.0): deploy-pages run 38348416477 succeeded; all assets 200, tests/ 404; live Playwright checks desktop 1280 + mobile 390 under the live CSP: sample (9 fixes, upgrades numpy 2.5.2 / pandas 3.0.6 / psycopg2-binary 2.9.13, pydantic-core routed to pydantic), uv.lock upload (pydantic: 163 pkgs, 12 flagged, offline), ?repo= deep link scan of open-webui/open-webui (337 deps, 60 to fix, verdicts spot-checked against PyPI), invalid/404 repo and empty input errors; no console errors other than the intentional 404; 16/16 unit tests; engine run on pydantic, poetry, flask, open-webui; 2 false-positive classes fixed (platform-only packages, test fixture lockfiles).
products.problem: Python 3.15.0 (Oct 9, 2026) needs new cp315/abi3 wheels; releases pinned before October never get them, so pip compiles numpy (<2.5.2), pandas (<3.0.6), psycopg2-binary (<2.9.13), pydantic-core, PyYAML (no 3.15 wheels yet) from source and slim/Alpine builds fail; torch 2.12.1 and ctranslate2 have no installable file at all. Docker python:3/latest/slim/alpine and setup-python '3.x' already resolve to 3.15, so teams land on it without choosing. 3.15 also removed sre_* modules, CGIHTTPRequestHandler, glob0/1, co_lnotab, load_module etc., and made strptime %d-without-year and positional sqlite3.connect args errors.
products.target_user: Python developers, maintainers and CI/Docker owners with pinned requirements/uv/Poetry/Pipenv lockfiles
evidence: Docker official-images library/python: 3, latest, slim, alpine -> 3.15.0 https://github.com/docker-library/official-images/blob/master/library/python
actions/python-versions manifest includes 3.15.0 (setup-python '3.x' resolves to it)
PyPI JSON checked Oct 13: numpy cp315 wheels only from 2.5.2, pandas from 3.0.6, psycopg2-binary from 2.9.13, PyYAML none; pip download --only-binary --python-version 3.15 numpy==2.2.6 fails

Real repos: open-webui/open-webui uv.lock has 8 packages with no installable 3.15 file (torch 2.12.1, ctranslate2 4.8.0, pywin32 on Windows) and 3 compiling from source; pydantic/pydantic locks 26 packages without 3.15 wheels
products.differentiation: Checks the exact pinned versions in your lockfile (requirements, uv.lock offline, poetry.lock offline, pylock.toml, Pipfile.lock) against real wheel tags per platform incl. abi3/abi3t/free-threaded, finds the smallest non-prerelease upgrade with wheels on all selected platforms, routes exact-pinned children to their parent (pydantic -> pydantic-core), plus 3.15 removed-API code scan and floating CI/Docker detection, all in the browser with no install.
products.monetization: none now; possible later: GitHub Action / PR comment that runs the same check on every lockfile change (free for public repos).
products.social_promotion: drafted (launch/py315-check/posts.md), not published: X/Bluesky/Facebook/Mastodon/Threads not connected

changelog.change: initial release: pinned-dependency 3.15 wheel check per platform via PyPI JSON + Simple API, smallest upgrade, parent-pin detection, uv/poetry/pylock offline, requires-python caps, removed-API/behaviour code rules, UTF-8 default note, .pth imports, floating Docker/setup-python detection, public repo scan, Markdown checklist
